10. To recalibrate, promptly access 'Temperature Calibration' in the Service Settings
blocks.content: Enter the temperature on the keypad as displayed on the calibrated digital thermometer and press the enter.

blocks.section: 10. To recalibrate, promptly access 'Temperature Calibration' in the Service Settings
blocks.content: The 'COMP:' temperature should now read the same as the entry.

blocks.section: 10. To recalibrate, promptly access 'Temperature Calibration' in the Service Settings
blocks.content: Monitor the 'RAW' oven temperature and compare to the calibrated digital thermometer. Repeat steps 11 & 12 if the calibration is requires further adjustment.

blocks.section: 10. To recalibrate, promptly access 'Temperature Calibration' in the Service Settings
blocks.content: Once the calibrated digital thermometer reading is in alignment with the RAW temperature, select the green check mark at the bottom of the screen and then pass on the test complete screen.

blocks.section: 10. To recalibrate, promptly access 'Temperature Calibration' in the Service Settings
blocks.content: Repeat the calibration check, points 5 to 9. Retesting to check that the cavity temperature reading is now within the recommended guidelines.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: Disconnect and isolate the appliance from the electricity supply and Lock off, see section 2.14 'Safe working when testing components'.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: Take protective measures to ensure the power cannot be switched on again.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: Allow the appliance to cool down.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: Remove the side and top panels of the casing.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: Discharge the capacitors and prove dead.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: Check the cavity temperature sensor wire and connections.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: If the wire and connections are correct and in good condition, replace the cavity temperature sensor (see Section 6.17. - Overview - further components).

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: Refit the panels of the casing.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: Switch ON the appliance and repeat the test procedure as described above.

blocks.section: If the temperature reading is unstable and not calibrating correctly:
blocks.content: If the temperature is still unstable repeat steps to make safe and replace the IO board (see Section 6.10 Replacing the IO board).
